description: fx2-cmix fork with split sidecar byte models, direct sidecar inputs, extra/page sidecar match contexts, WRT-learned dictionary expansion, and decoded WRT word characters feeding title/link/template/ref semantic hashes.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
hypothesis: The previous WRT-learn sidecar only expanded dictionary words into suffix checks; this variant also lets decoded word characters update semantic hashes so entity and template contexts can distinguish dictionary-coded titles, links, params, refs, and template names.
verdict: Pruned on the scored 250k gate. WRT decoded hashing tied the WRT-learn archive but increased counted package size.
